Load cached options data previously downloaded using av_add_options()

Source: R/av_appRfuncs.R
av_load_cached_opts.Rd

Returns a data.table of options data given a data.table of keys desired or a set of parameters.

Usage

av_load_cached_opts(optsDT = NULL, symbols = NULL, dtstr = "")

Arguments

optsDT

(default: NULL) A data.frame of symbols and optional keys (ts, expiration, expcode, type) to join with data.

symbols

(default: NULL) Ticker or list of tickers for which option data is returned.

dtstr

(default: "") Dates for which to return options. Works with both optsDT and symbols specfication.

Value

data.table with full option data.

Details

Load Options data from parquet files

See also

av_runShiny()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
opttest1=av_load_cached_opts(symbols="JPM;GS",dtstr="-2m::")
opttest2=av_load_cached_opts(optsDT=CJ(symbol=c("JPM","GS"), expcode=c("MO_1","MO_2"), type=c("call")), dtstr="-1y::")
opttest2[,.(min(ts),max(ts)), by=.(expcode,symbol,type)]
} # }
